summary:
Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday, near the Ukrainian border, and NATO condemned what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. Sources differ on the count: one gives three projectiles, another two missiles and a suspected drone. Poland's prime minister said the incidents were likely a provocation timed to European military exercises in the country. Warsaw accuses Moscow of intentional provocation, but the bar for invoking NATO's collective defence clause remains high.

The UK and the EU signed three agreements on Friday at a summit in Brussels, aimed at easing food export checks, linking their emissions trading schemes and boosting youth mobility. An agreement on university tuition fees was pushed back, and Brussels sources had suggested the wider deal might not apply until fees were lowered for EU students in Britain. Miliband said the deal does not depend on a fees agreement.

A mathematician at the AI company Anthropic said on Friday that he had used its Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a problem that has eluded mathematicians for more than 160 years. He said he believed he had discovered a proof working with Claude. The claim still needs independent verification.

headlines.title: Russian projectiles land in Poland as NATO condemns airspace violation
headlines.summary: Three Russian projectiles, or two missiles and a suspected drone by another count, came down in Poland on Friday near the Ukrainian border. NATO called it a grave violation of Polish airspace, and Warsaw accuses Moscow of intentional provocation.

headlines.title: UK and EU sign three agreements, delaying tuition fees deal
headlines.summary: The UK and EU signed agreements on food trade, emissions trading links and youth mobility at a Brussels summit on Friday. An agreement on university tuition fees was pushed back, with Brussels sources suggesting the wider deal may wait until fees for EU students in Britain are lowered.

headlines.title: Anthropic researcher says Claude helped prove Riemann Hypothesis
headlines.summary: A mathematician at Anthropic said on Friday he had used the Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a problem unsolved for more than 160 years. The proof still needs independent verification, and it follows another recent claim that an AI company or someone linked to one had solved a famous maths problem.

headlines.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plot to kill Ukrainian-American rapper
headlines.summary: Denmark accused Moscow of being behind a failed assassination attempt against a Ukrainian-American rapper in Copenhagen and expelled Russia's defence attaché. The Russian embassy in Denmark has denied the allegation.

headlines.title: UN killer robot talks extend discussions, pledging rules by 2028
headlines.summary: UN talks in Geneva on weapons with little or no human oversight ended Saturday with a pledge to develop new rules within two years. Russia's opposition weakened the outcome, and human rights groups said it was disappointing.

headlines.title: Trump threatens tax on US firms building AI data centres overseas
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump on Friday threatened a tremendous tax on US companies that build artificial intelligence data centres abroad. He gave no details, and said others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

headlines.title: EU proposes tax on Big Tech to help fund its budget
headlines.summary: European Council President Antonio Costa unveiled a spending proposal on Saturday that would tax the world's biggest digital companies. The plan cuts 204 billion euros from a budget proposal first put forward by the European Commission.

headlines.title: COP31 climate talks run into overtime over fossil fuels
headlines.summary: Negotiators from nearly 200 countries ran past the scheduled end of the two-week COP31 climate conference on Friday, divided over fossil fuels and climate finance. Environmental groups tracking the talks put pressure on host Turkey.
